Frozen contract: CommandContribution/CommandDecoration/CommandUiSpec/SelectOption types plus the ctx.commandUi face (register/decorate/dismiss/popupFor).
Session-keyed command catalog cache: cold/pending/ready/failed states, epoch guard on publishes, soft invalidateAll, hard resetConnected, strong-wait ensureReady.
Browser plugin body: registers the "command" locale namespace, mounts CommandUiRuntime, and injects the popupSelect shell into the conversation.input.overlay slot per session.
The "command" namespace dictionary pair (zh is the key-set source of truth, en is checked against it) with section headings, built-in faces, claim tokens and popup shell copy.
groupOptions(): first-occurrence grouping of SelectOption rows by caller-owned group name, used by both filtering and rendering.
Headless popupSelect controller: binding-identity revocation of late settlements, local-only search, single-flight select, risk-confirmation gate, retry on failed options load.
popupSelect card styles: absolutely positioned above the composer anchor, 320px design cap, ellipsised label/detail, transparent search field, error strip with retry.
The popupSelect shell view: holds focus while open, local filtering, ↑↓/Enter/Tab/Escape/Shift+Tab keys, outside-pointerdown dismissal, RiskConfirmation modal, scrollIntoView of the highlighted row.
Localized face of the six built-in host commands (title, description, glyph) plus the two-section empty-query menu order (Add: file/goal/plan/feedback; Commands: compact/permission/model/export).
First-party command identity by definitionId and the bilingual claim-token alias table; resolveCommand prefers exact name, then alias by definitionId.

CommandUiRuntime: the / trigger source, candidate synthesis (host catalog + contributions, collision fails loud), the space/enter/menu decision tables, execute admission semantics, and the per-session popup registry.
Two-line ambient declaration for *.module.css class maps; identical in all three packages of this shard.
Host (node) half: an intentional no-op apply() so the plugin appears in the host loader; the browser half ships through exports["./client"].
Real-cordis test: plugin mounts CommandUiRuntime, registers the "/" source, injects the overlay entry per sessionId (unknown id fails loud), and folds up on fiber disposal.
Per-key cache specs: status transitions, the epoch guard (a superseded pull cannot overwrite or demote a newer one), invalidateAll, resetConnected, resetSession, warm, ensureReady rejection on abort.
jsdom interaction spec for the shell: search focus, local filtering, arrow/Enter/Tab/Escape, card height clamp (320px vs 188px), gated option modal, submitting lock, outside pointerdown dismissal.
Controller specs: highlight parks on the active row, options loaded exactly once, reopen aborts the old load, single-flight select, dismiss/dispose racing a settling onSelect revokes it.

Runtime specs on a real cordis Context: candidate synthesis, dispatch decision table cell by cell, matchSpace hot-key policy, matchEnter strong-wait, envelope/attachment policy, execute payload and detached admission notices.

Project references list (api/remotes, api/session-controller, cordis, locale, store, ui-conversation, ui-primitives, ui-renderer, ui-session, ui-input-trigger, ui-slots, interaction/commands, core/session, util/values).

Manifest: "split-tree engine with invertible operations" + React components, zero cordis runtime use, exports lib/index.js and lib/**/*.css only.
Per-heading EN/ZH hash record for the dockkit README pair.

Package reference: the two-layer split (pure engine vs components), the interaction rules that "each fix a defect found in a real browser", and the declared limitations (no separator role, no keyboard split/move/float).
Chinese mirror of the dockkit README, including the seven "interaction rules worth keeping" bullets.

One 838-line stylesheet: token-only colours, divider that takes no layout room, chip box as the strip's only shrinking part, mask-based edge fades, macOS app-region subtraction, Windows caption clearance.
The docked surface: hit-test for strips/zones, divider drag preview, the room-rule re-measure loop, and the release that produces exactly one settled intent per gesture.
Floating overlay panels in viewport coordinates with their own move/resize gestures; a press released in place raises the panel, a drag records only the move or resize.
DOM side of the room rule: reads pane/strip/chip/fill rectangles and computed styles, then answers halvesFit per pane; an unmeasured pane reads as fitting.
Recursive renderer for the split tree: nested flex runs sized by fractions, with a live divider drag rendering preview fractions instead of the recorded ones.
Pointer ownership: capture is hardening, window listeners carry the gesture, only the owning pointerId counts, one gesture at a time per component.
Internal prop share (PaneCallbacks) the kit's own components pass among themselves; the outward contracts live in contract/adapter.ts.
Stable DOM cells for every tab across selection/move/float (sorted by tab id so React never reparents a connected webview ancestor), plus keepMounted retention and focus handoff.
Per-tab context menu in a portal: measured then positioned, dismisses on outside press or unmodified Escape, restores focus without a ring, and refuses to paint an empty menu.
One pane: the tab strip (drag source, drop target, split control, add control), WAI-ARIA manual-activation keyboard handling, the drop-hint overlay, and the "focus lands on click, not on press" rule.
A chip title that is never ellipsized: the clipped flag is written straight to the DOM (data-dockkit-tab-clipped) so the stylesheet can fade the text under a mask.
Outward contracts: DockLabels (every rendered string, already localized), TabRenderer, TabMenuExtras, and DockIntents (one call per settled gesture, never a drag frame).
Model types: branded PaneId/SplitId/TabId, the normalized split tree, the closed LayoutOp union, and the inverse-producing ApplyResult.
Ambient CSS-module declaration, same two lines as the sibling packages.
Pure interaction limits: 4-pane cap, 0.12 minimum pane fraction, float sizes, the five dock zones, and the clampSizes floor-pinning algorithm.
DockController: the stateful intent layer — every method is a planner call plus recording plus one notification; a planner returning no operations records nothing.
Pure drag geometry: point tests, zone resolution, strip insertion slots, the room rule (halvesFit) with its pixel minimums, and the float rectangle helpers.
Id minter (the one place a string becomes a branded id) and createInitialState, whose first tab belongs to the state rather than to an operation.
The operation engine: one pure applyOp returning the next state AND the operations that undo it; every created id travels inside the operation so replay is exact.
Pure planners (planSplitPane, planOpenContent, planPlaceTab, planDropTab, planFloatTab, planSettle): mint ids, enforce limits, and return [] when the intent changes nothing.
Linear history: record/stepBack/stepForward as pure functions over plain History plus a mutable Sequencer wrapper; a run of focus-only entries undoes as one step.
Pure tree helpers: readers that throw on a dangling id, writers that preserve untouched node identity, findParent/findTabPane by scan, and topRightPaneId for the chrome seat.
Public surface re-export map for the whole kit (model, operations, history, geometry, planners, controller, contracts, React components).
Asserts against dockkit.module.css on disk: exactly one -webkit-app-region rule, darwin-scoped, and the Windows float header's 20px caption clearance.
Operation-engine specs: every op's tree effect plus an expectRoundTrip that applies the inverse and requires the exact original state back.
1633-line component spec: focus-on-click, split control blocking, room readings through onRoom, chip fades, menus, tab drags, divider drags, float gestures, chrome placement.
Specs for the four-pane cap, the five dock regions and their split mapping, and the clampSizes floor algorithm including the multi-pass pin case.
Controller specs: expand/collapse recording, split seeding, tab identity (same content focuses rather than opens), drop resolution, floating cascade, and the one-entry-per-compound-command undo.
Shared fixtures: seed/file tab factories, a seeded controller, a label set, and the asPane/asSplit/asTab brand helpers for specs.
Specs for containsPoint, zoneInRect, insertionIndex, the drag threshold, divider arithmetic, float rectangles, and the halvesFit boundary cases (412px fits, 411px does not).
jsdom specs for the measurement side: pane discovery by data attribute, chip minimum from computed style (content-box vs border-box), divider thickness fallback, and sameFits.

Planner specs: determinism (same inputs → same operations), input state untouched, [] for no-op intents, planPlaceTab caret arithmetic, planDropTab backfill, planSettle, and one undo behaviour across both embeddings.
History specs: focus-run undo collapsing, exact round-trip, redo-branch discard, replay equality at any cursor, and a float drag recorded as one step.
jsdom specs for stable tab cells: body retention, focus handoff rules, ancestors preserved across moves/floats, and the superseding-gesture marker.
Project references (util/brand, ui-primitives) over tsconfig.base.client.json.
Static-linked bundle preset: one browser ESM bundle at lib/index.js with the stylesheet shipped under lib/ at its src-relative path.

Chinese package metadata (title "应用布局" plus one-line description).
Manifest: "three-column AppFrame with drag handles, ctx.layout viewing-state service", dsh.client.inject list, ./client export split.
Per-heading EN/ZH hash record for the layout README pair.
Package reference: the three-column frame and its width concessions, the window-chrome seat, the theme presenter projection, and the declared limitations (transient geometry, no scroll anchoring).
Chinese mirror of the layout README, including the window-chrome seat and theme-presentation sections.
Frame styles: the data-animating/data-dragging transition split, macOS vibrancy and reduced-transparency handling, the published clearance variables, and the pointer-events:none overlay layer.

The three-column frame: grid template that delegates the squeeze to CSS, rAF-throttled ResizeObserver measurement, frozen drag bases, the animation-settle window, and the right column as a track rather than a box.
Pure column solve: clampWidth plus computeColumns, which shrinks the right column, then drops its track, before the centre may fall below its 400px minimum.
Browser title projection: the session title only while the Conversation is the active main panel, product title otherwise, restored on unmount.
Browser plugin body: declares the six frame child slots, seats the layout store, provides ctx.layout, registers the Mod+B sidebar shortcut, and starts the theme presenter effect.
LayoutController (ctx.layout): selectPanel against the live registry, beginNavigation's abort-on-supersede, and the right-panel show/hide reports.
Two-line label dictionary for the layout shortcut namespace (zh source of truth, en typed against it).
The layout store: panelInfo separated from layoutInfo, sidebar/rightbar width preferences and clamps, the narrow-expanded override, and the rightbarInstant transition marker.
ThemePresenter: pure DOM projection of a ThemeSnapshot onto the document, with a retraction set so only its own writes are removed on dispose.
Ambient CSS-module declaration, same two lines as the sibling packages.
Host (node) half: a no-op apply() so the plugin appears in the host loader; the browser half ships through exports["./client"].
681-line frame spec: title projection, owner props, macOS/Windows chrome seats, width concessions, the animating/instant markers, pointer resizing, and the frame measurement lifecycle.
Plugin-level spec on a real cordis Context: service dependencies, the six child-slot declarations, the shared store instance, panel deregistration, theme presenter teardown, and full fibre teardown.
Specs for clampWidth and computeColumns, including a 9-case table of frame/sidebar/right/centre outcomes and the "never reduces the wide sidebar" rule.
Specs for the title projection: durable title updates, global-panel fallback, and the return to the latest session title.

Store specs: initial state, no browser persistence, sidebar clamps, the 1024px breakpoint rule, panelInfo identity separation, right-panel preference lifetime, and the instant-geometry marker transitions.
Controller specs: forwarding to the store actions, rejecting an unregistered main panel without cancelling pending navigation, and abort-on-supersede across select/beginNavigation/dispose.
jsdom specs for the presenter: color-scheme, the dark attribute, token replacement, font sizes and lists, the theme-source attribute, and a dispose that spares foreign inline styles.
Project references list (brand, cordis, locale, ui-slots, ui-theme, ui-primitives, store, ui-renderer, ui-session, shortcuts).
Three-line bundle config using the shared clientBundle helper with lib/types/index.js as the DTS entry.
